name: Hung & Sliding Windows
description: Kawneer aluminum windows are designed to increase daylighting, ventilation and provide quality views to the outside while providing high thermal performance and energy efficiency. The range of Kawneer windows allow you to have increase design flexibility, thermal options and offer more aesthetic choices for new and retrofit construction. Kawneer Hung & Sliding Windows featuring: OptiQ™ AA™5450 Series Windows, AA™3350 Thermal Windows, TR-9100 Windows, 8400TL Thermal Windows , TR-9900 Windows, TR-9800 Windows, TR-9700 Windows, TR-9400 Windows, TR-6800 Windows, NX-5000 Windows, NX-5400 Windows, NX-6000 Windows, and NX-6400 Windows A hung window is a window consisting of vertical sliding sash which utilize counterbalancing devices to allow the sash to be opened to any variable position between its fully open and fully closed limits. Common types are single hung, double hung and triple hung. A horizontal sliding window is a window that consists of one or more sash that slide or roll horizontally within a common frame, and can also consist of fixed lites/sash. Thermal performance is a key attribute of Kawneer windows which helps to reduce energy demands. Kawneer windows are thermally broken to improve thermal resistance. Thermal barriers are created using two methods: insertion of low conductance material and poured polymers. TM TM OPTIQ AA 5450 HUNG WINDOW Performance Standards Kawneer products are tested, certified and labeled for the following performance standards: AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/IS2/A440 (NAFS-North American Fenestration Standard/Specification for windows, doors, and skylights) for the most current version ASTM E283, AAMA 501 and NFRC 400 Air Leakage ASTME331 and AAMA 501 Water Penetration ASTME330 and AAMA 501 Static Structural Performance AAMA 1503, AAMA 507 and NFRC 100 Thermal Transmittance - U-Factors AAMA 1503, CSA A440.2 and NFRC 500 Condensation Resistance (CRF,I,CR) AAMA 507 and NFRC 200 Overall Solar Heat Gain Coefficient and Visible Transmittance (SHGC)
